title: lmdb: path stuck in OPEN_PATHS after failed env open
description:
## Bug

In LmdbBlockDb::open(), the canonicalized path is inserted into OPEN_PATHS before EnvOpenOptions::new().open() is called. If the open (or subsequent write_txn/create_database/commit) fails, the function returns Err via ?, but the path is not removed from OPEN_PATHS. The Drop impl only runs when LmdbBlockDb is successfully constructed.

Result: after any failure in the open() method between the OPEN_PATHS insert and the Ok(Self{...}) return, the path is permanently locked in OPEN_PATHS. The process cannot retry opening the same LMDB environment without restarting.

## Fix

Use a cleanup guard (a struct that removes the path from OPEN_PATHS in its Drop), and defuse the guard only on successful construction.
